mapper.select: select distinct activity.id, '主舞台・' || activity."name" as note, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "value", TO_CHAR(TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'FMMM"月"FMDD"日"') || ' (' || CASE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM TO_DATE("session"."date", 'YYYY/MM/DD')) WHEN 1 THEN '一' WHEN 2 THEN '二' WHEN 3 THEN '三' WHEN 4 THEN '四' WHEN 5 THEN '五' WHEN 6 THEN '六' WHEN 7 THEN '日' end || ') ' AS "label" FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity INNER JOIN "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" ON activity.id = "session".activity_id where activity.id = #{activity_id} ORDER BY activity.id

select "session".id, "session"."time" as "value", "session"."time" || ' ' || CASE WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN "session"."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS "label", "session".capacity as available FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" where "session"."date" = #{date} and "session".activity_id = #{activity_id} ORDER BY "session"."date"

select ticket.orderno, ticket.session_id, ticket."name", ticket."date", ticket."time", CASE WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '06:00'::time AND '11:59:59'::time THEN '早晨場' WHEN ticket."time"::time BETWEEN '12:00'::time AND '17:59:59'::time THEN '午後場' ELSE '星空場' END AS timename, ticket.status FROM "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ticket WHERE ticket.customer = #{customer} ORDER BY ticket.orderno desc
select activity.id, activity.price FROM "interviewworks_ticket"."activity" activity where activity.id = #{activity_id}
mapper.update: update "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" set capacity = capacity - 1, reserved = reserved + 1 where "session".id = #{session_id} and "session".capacity - "session".reserved - "session".sold >= 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "interviewworks_ticket".ticket ( orderno, session_id, customer, email, "name", "date", "time", status, quantity, price, expires_at, paid_at, cancelled_at ) VALUES ( #{orderno}, #{session_id}, #{customer}, #{email}, #{name}, #{date}, #{time}, #{status}, 1, #{price}, #{expires_at}, #{paid_at}, #{cancelled_at} ) ON CONFLICT (orderno) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: update "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" set capacity = capacity + 1, reserved = reserved - 1 where "session".id = #{session_id} and "session".capacity - "session".reserved - "session".sold >= 1
mapper.select: select distinct "session".activity, "session"."date", "session"."time", "session".salesdate, "session".salestime from "interviewworks_ticket"."session" "session" where "session".activity = #{activity} and "session"."date" = #{date} and "session"."time" = #{time} order by "session"."date" desc
mapper.update: WITH paid_ticket AS ( UPDATE interviewworks_ticket.ticket AS ticket SET status = '已付款', payprice = ticket.price WHERE ticket.orderno = #{orderno} AND ticket.customer = #{customer} AND ticket."name" = #{activity} AND ticket."date" = #{date} AND ticket."time" = #{time} AND ticket.status = '待付款' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM interviewworks_ticket."session" AS s WHERE s.activity = ticket."name" AND s."date" = ticket."date" AND s."time" = ticket."time" AND s.capacity > 0 ) RETURNING ticket."name", ticket."date", ticket."time" ) UPDATE interviewworks_ticket."session" AS s SET capacity = s.capacity - 1, sold = s.sold + 1 FROM paid_ticket AS p WHERE s.activity = p."name" AND s."date" = p."date" AND s."time" = p."time" AND s.capacity > 0
